items.description:

items.title: ECP fixes Feb 7 as polling date for first phase of Punjab local govt elections
items.description:
ISLAMABAD: The Election Commission of Pakistan (ECP) on Thursday decided to hold the first phase of local government elections in Punjab on Feb 7, 2027, accepting the provincial government’s request to schedule polling after Jan 20 in view of fog and weather conditions.
ECP had initially proposed holding the elections on December 14.
Thursday’s decision was taken by a four-member bench headed by Chief Election Commissioner Sikandar Sultan Raja and comprising members Nisar Ahmed Durrani, Shah Muhammad Jatoi and Babar Hassan Bharwana during a hearing on the conduct of local government elections

items.description:

Rescue 1122’s Chief Operating Officer Dr Abid Shaikh said the incident occurred during ongoing construction work at the shop.
He added that three victims had been recovered from the debris and shifted to hospital, while more people are feared to be trapped under the rubble.

items.title: France braces for demonstrations as trade unions strike
items.description:
Hundreds of thousands of people are expected to take to the streets across France on Thursday, as unions hold strikes alongside student-led demonstrations that have gripped the country for weeks.
The high school student movement that began with youth protesting dismal learning conditions has coincided with widespread anger over the rising cost of living and inequality, which culminated on October 17 in the worst rioting France has seen in years.

items.description:

items.title: Swat basin faces over 5°C warming by century’s end
items.description:
ISLAMABAD: A glacier risk assessment of the Swat watershed has war­ned that the basin is expected to warm by more than 5°C by the end of the century, particularly bet­ween October and June. 

Winter rainfall is expected to change little, but summer rainfall could more than double under some climate scenarios, according to the assessment carried out by the Green Climate Fund (GCF), with support from the Asian Development Bank (ADB).
